title: Brevo: Email & SMS Marketing, CRM & Automation Platform
northstar: Cool, spacious digital architecture: clean sans-serif, muted teal and warm graphite hues.
autopsy:
FOLD: Top nav: logo left, four dropdowns, globe icon, "Log in", pill "Sign Up Free", outline "Get a demo" right. Headline: sentence case, left-aligned, ~48px, 3 lines, "Turn Every Order into a Lifetime Customer". Body: 2-line paragraph. Two CTAs: filled black pill "Sign up free" above, social proof (4.5 stars, G2 badge) below. Hero: dashboard UI collage, right 55% of viewport, overlapping cards showing CRM data, campaign stats, revenue graphs. Left text block balances right visual at ~45/55 split.

TYPE: Sans-serif display (Tomato Grotesk), medium weight, slightly condensed; body same family lighter. ~3:1 scale jump. Sentence case throughout, tight tracking on headline.

COLOR: Background #c4fca4 (mint green). Text near-black. Accent #dc9140 (terracotta) appears in dashboard UI charts/badges only, not CTAs. Buttons black-on-white inverse.

SIGNATURE: Mint green full-bleed hero background with realistic SaaS dashboard collage floating at right edge, breaking the frame.
description: Brevo is the most intuitive all-in-one customer engagement platform: email and SMS marketing, automation, CRM, live chat, and transactional email. Try it free.
